foot: Pramukh Swami Maharaj 1974, 1990, 2007   ·   Mahant Swami Maharaj 2017, 2026

cards.caption: Performs the pujan of Swaminarayan-Siddhant-Sudha, authored by Mahamahopadhyaya Bhadreshdas Swami
Listens attentively to the discourses by various learned swamis
Joined the discourses again at 4pm, as bhaktas reconvened after lunch and a short break
Addressed the assembly after his puja
Emerges from his room at 5.20am to make his way to the abhishek mandap
At one point, Bapa asked for the microphone, sharing his own reflections upon the on-going discourses
'We are forever indebted to Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Shastriji Maharaj for revealing and clarifying these two eternal entities to us - Akshar and Purushottam.'
Had spent a total of more than seven hours in the chhavani, and spoken four times
Blesses the 'Rajipo' book and a scholar's hat for all the vidvans and vidushis
Reads the Shikshapatri and Satsang Diksha
Applies a chandlo within the tilak
Commences his puja by applying a tilak on his forehead
Adarshjivandas Swami performs the pujan of Bapa
Interacting with the swamis in the afternoon
Blesses the children again as he departs
